jobs.description: As a Banquet Porter, you will be responsible for:• Setting up tables and chairs in meeting and event rooms for meetings, lunches, dinners and events according to the specified layout.•Clearing rooms and moving or supplying furniture as required.•Providing specific meeting equipment, such as lecterns and flipcharts.•Carrying out small cleaning and tidying tasks to ensure the room is presented to the desired standard.Your profileWe are looking for a colleague who:• Can work both independently and as part of a team.•Is flexible and comfortable working different shifts.• Has a good command of the Dutch and/or English language.• Has a strong service-oriented attitude.

INTENSIVE CARE NURSEAs an ICU nurse in training, you learn to independently perform nursing interventions and actions to stabilize or keep vital functions stable. In addition to the acute and technical aspects of intensive care, you are responsible for the psychosocial guidance of the patient and his or her loved ones.Your profile:·Bachelor of Nursing degree obtained in an EU/EEA country.·EU nationality.·Willing to follow a paid for educational program to become an ICU nurse in the Netherlands.·Certified nurse with a minimum of 2 years of experience in an Intensive Care (IC) unit, and a commitment to continuous professional growth.·Desire to contribute to an excellent team, recognizing that good care is a collaborative effort.·Decisive and result-oriented with an understanding of the critical nature of every minute in the Intensive Care (IC).·Strong listening skills and empathy, recognizing the challenges families face in the ICU.·Eagerness to learn, with a recognition that each working day is an opportunity for personal and professional development.·Availability for all shifts, contributing to our 24/7 care commitment.·English proficiency at A2/B1 level.Employment conditions·Before obtaining the Dutch nursing registration, an initial gross annual salary starting approx. €27.348,00 (up until €39.312,00) based on 36 hours per week according to the Dutch Labor Agreement for Hospitals (CAO NVZ-FWG 35).·After obtaining the Dutch nursing registration, an initial gross annual salary starting at approx. €33.984,00 (up until €45.888,00) based on 36 hours per week according to the Dutch Labor Agreement for Hospitals (CAO NVZ-FWG 45).·22.5 vacation days.·Holiday Pay and Year-end Bonus·Free Dutch language course, accommodation, and meals at Academia Neerlandesa.·Cultural and professional experience.·Access to a European network of nurses.
